[About AAA]

# About AAA

AAA provides more than 65 million members with automotive, travel, insurance and financial services
across North America. Established in 1902, AAA is a leader in advocacy for motorists and road safety
by working with local and federal governments to change and enact laws. In addition to having access
to premier roadside assistance, AAA members benefit from a variety of shopping, dining, hotel and
entertainment discounts that help you save money.
[Membership]

# Membership

A [AAA membership][6] offers so much more than roadside assistance. Each member has access to
countless deals and discounts on everyday purchases, including special rates on hotels, theme park
tickets, sporting events, gas and more. Join today to start using these exclusive member benefits.
[Savings and Discounts]

# Savings & Discounts

AAA members can save money at places where you may already shop, dine and visit. These savings
include discounts on restaurants, eyewear, laptops, appliances, gas, car rentals, hotels, and
tickets to attractions, concerts, movies and sporting events. Join today and immediately start using
[AAA discounts][7] when you shop across more than 100,000 discount partners.
[Automotive Services]

# Automotive Services

AAA is the most trusted roadside assistance service in North America. Supported by a fleet of
certified technicians, AAA members are just a tap, click or call away from receiving 24/7 assistance
for [automotive services][8] relating to jumpstarts, lockouts, battery replacements, tire changes,
tows and more. In search of a trusted auto repair shop? AAA’s list of nearly 7,000 approved auto
repair facilities provides confidence and reliability when deciding where to get your car fixed.
[Home and Auto Insurance]

# Home and Auto Insurance

Unforeseen circumstances are a part of life, but there are steps you can take to ensure you're
prepared when something happens. AAA offers both home and auto insurance so members can feel safe
and protected at home and on the road.
[Financial Services]

# Financial Services

AAA offers members a variety of financial services, including some of the best cash back [credit
cards][9] for travel and everyday purchases with no annual fees. In addition to that, all AAA
members receive free identity theft protection monitoring so you can have peace of mind when making
purchases.
[Travel]

# Travel

One of the best benefits of becoming a AAA member is gaining access to a team of experienced travel
agents to help you plan and book your dream vacation. Whether you're traveling within the U.S. or
internationally, AAA has access to special travel offers and discounts that help you save every step
of the way.
Going on a road trip? Use [TripTik][10] to plan your route and learn what might be worth a visit
along the way. Need travel inspiration? Visit [Trip Canvas][11] to research destinations and book
your next vacation. Members also can get assistance with [International Driving Permits][12], travel
insurance and expedited [passport services][13].

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# We are
# Eckert & Ziegler
# Medical

As one of two business segments of the Eckert & Ziegler group we represent the combined efforts to
provide highest quality products and comprehensive services to support customer success in nuclear
medicine, radiation therapy and beyond.

[ See our Products ][17]
Radiation Therapy
Radiopharmaceuticals & Chemicals
Radiopharmaceutical Development
Radiosynthesis & QC Solutions
Hot Cells & Radiation Protection Solutions
Contract Manufacturing
Regulatory Support
Radioactive Logistics

Browse Our Products and Services

Medical products for the treatment of cancer using [brachytherapy][18] and [radiotherapy
accessories][19].

A wide range of [radionuclides][20] (GMP and chemical grade) for research, diagnostic and
therapeutical applications in nuclear medicine and beyond

[Development][21] as well as process design and scale-up for PET tracers, kits and
radiopharmaceuticals including automation and validation of all processes

Automated solutions for [radiolabeling][22] of PET tracers and formulation of kits as well as their
respective [quality control][23] (TLC, HPLC)

From standardized work environments to highly sophisticated fully automated [systems][24] – Ideally
suited to protect people, product and the environment

[GMP suites][25] as well as clinical and commercial supply for projects using alpha, beta or gamma
radiation with customized [solutions][26] tailored to your specifications

[Services][27] for the approval of pharmaceuticals and manufacturers including validation as well as
qualification of laboratory equipment

Consulting services and provision of dedicated packaging for the [shipment and distribution][28] of
radiopharmaceuticals and other radioactive goods

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,

brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Al Infrad Trading Co.

Al Infrad Trading Co. was established in 1995 as a specialized healthcare company in Saudi Arabia.
Since its inception, the establishment has focused on supplying and equipping medical laboratories
with a wide range of high-quality laboratory instruments, reagents, and consumables, in addition to
providing comprehensive laboratory setup and installation solutions in accordance with international
standards.
The Company is efficiently managed under the leadership of Mr. Abdul Rahman Al Zoabie, General
Manager, with a commitment to delivering integrated laboratory solutions that support the healthcare
sector and contribute to enhancing the quality of diagnostic services across the Kingdom.

[Learn More][22]

The Engineering Department is well-equipped with sophisticated facilities that enable our engineers
to prototype, test, and act on any instruments easily, all in accordance with manufacturer
standards.

Our company is a specialized provider of laboratory setup and equipment solutions for medical

#### Dedicated to Providing the Best in Health Care Solutions

 

Established in 1994, as one of the leading medical distributors in Saudi Arabia, Al-Khateeb Medical
has been providing unparalleled medical solutions and customer support to all corners of the
Kingdom. This has been achieved through a dedicated team of highly qualified and experienced
engineers. Such dedication and drive enabled Al-Khateeb to achieve double digit growth figures, as
well as high customer satisfaction rates throughout its operational life.


Ranked as an “A” standard medical  establishment by the Saudi FDA, which  is the highest ranking
available.

 

Al-Khateeb Medical strives to provide the doctors and practitioners of Saudi Arabia with the most
optimal solutions, through the careful analysis of their needs. The philosophy of providing
solutions instead of products is a primary goal of Al-Khateeb, to ensure that doctors are
comfortable with the knowledge that the patient is consistently safe within their hands.

 

In short, Al-Khateeb Medical cares.

Al-Khateeb Medical focuses on the following fields to ensure a consistent market leading position

* Emergency Medical Services

* Hospital Furniture

##### Our Partners

satisfy our customer requirements to the best of our joint abilities.

Customer Oriented Focus

We believe that constantly investing in the development of our team's knowledge and skills, allows
us to differentiate ourselves from the competition, and to provide our customers with the wow

We believe that a clear, transparent, ethical and accountable business process is essential to

# Serving all of KSA's major public and private hospitals

[ Contact us ][11]

We are a licensed and regulated distributor of medical devices and pharmaceutical products in the
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Founded in 2014, AlwanMed today is the authorized KSA representative and
distributor for a number of international manufacturers and wholesalers. We currently serve all of
KSA’s major government and private healthcare providers through our two office locations in Riyadh
and Jeddah. Our advanced centralized warehousing and logistics capabilities ensure the dependable
and consistent delivery of medical products. We continue to foster our growth by establishing
life-long partnerships with new suppliers, in addition to our existing partners.

Direct Purchase and Public Sector Procurements Narcotic & controlled importation, distribution, and
logistics Warehousing and distribution Unregistered and specialty pharma importation Tender
submissions and preparation Working capital management and purchase order financing

## Direct Purchase and Public Sector Procurements

Alwanmed provides its service to both government and private hospitals through its presence in the
general public tenders that organizes procurement of hospital needs. We currently provide direct
deliveries of its products to nearly 20% of hospitals kingdom wide.

## Narcotic & controlled importation, distribution, and logistics

Alwanmed is among 21 Saudi medical companies that are SFDA licensed for legal import of narcotic
pharmaceutical products and psychotropics medications. A service that is provided only by very few
in KSA to the health facilities through the mandatory system of electronic narcotic program (NDM).
Our company is among have a supply chain that serves more than 80% of Saudi hospitals with their
narcotic needs in all regions.

## Warehousing and distribution

Our warehouse facility is practiced under the permission of the SFDA and as per its regulations. It
also complies with ISO standard 13485 for medical facilities to assure the customers of their
dedication to quality. Afleet of cold chain monitored vehicles contribute to the effort of providing
our customers with their products as per manufacturer storage guidelines.

## Unregistered and specialty pharma importation

AlwanMed is a specialist in pharmaceutical import of both generic and branded pharmaceuticals around
the globe. Sourcing products from verified UK, US, Australian, German & Canadian manufacturers
producing quality products following the internationally recognized ‘Conditions of Good
Manufacturing Practice’. We provide our customers with a vast selection of high-quality
pharmaceuticals at competitive prices through a professional, reliable service. Our premises are
designed and equipped to store and distribute all medicinal products in accordance with the SFDA
guidelines

## Tender submissions and preparation

We provide solid analytics of the market based on proprietary data of 20,000 Qs, Pos and tender
awards. In addition to the different types of tender documents, logistics management, actual
billings and financing. This helps with the submission of well-balanced offers that guarantees high
percentage of awardation.

## Working capital management and purchase order financing

Alwanmed keeps a credible rating for its financing in the market through optimization of its working
capital Loan and Purchase Order financing to give our business the kind of capital flexibility it
needs. This helps us to respond correctly to the market increased needs when conditions arise.

### Working capital management and purchase order financing

## SFDA Representation and Product Registrations

Medical device and pharmaceutical manufacturers with no legal presence in the Kingdom of Saudi
Arabia (KSA) must appoint a Saudi Authorized Representative (medical devices) or an authorized Agent
(drugs). In addition to distribution, billing, collections, and other on-the-ground support
functions, as a KSA Authorized Representative/Agent, AlwanMed serves as a liaison between a number
of global manufacturers and the Saudi Food & Drug Authority (SFDA), the country’s medical device and
pharmaceuticals regulator

reflecting a clear shift toward centralising GCC operations.

reaching 76%, businesses are expanding operations structured around local supply chains and
regulatory frameworks.

### Know the Different Foreign Ownership Business Structures in Saudi Arabia

There are multiple foreign company structures available in the market to consider, depending on your
business goals for company formation. Each type serves different objectives, for different market
entry models and our company formation consultants in Saudi Arabia guide businesses through
registration, approvals, and documentation processes on track. 

### [Limited Liability Company.][159]

A Limited Liability Company limits shareholder liability to invested capital. It supports full
operations, hiring, and expansion, with defined reporting, audit, and compliance requirements for
structured business activities.

liability, while the branch manages operations and commercial activities under its own name.

country-level depth where decisions are won or lost. We advise pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech
leaders on launch, access, and growth; and extend the same evidence discipline to B2B, consumer, and
industrial clients where market entry, pricing, and stakeholder behaviour shape commercial outcomes.

#### [Market Entry][32]

CODADA supports structured market entry into Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. We help you find the
right partners, navigate compliance, and manage local follow-up - ensuring faster access and
long-term success across FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and retail sectors.

#### [Market & Trade Representation][33]

Establishing a strong presence in local markets can be challenging. CODADA represents products,
brands, and companies in Asia and the Middle East on their behalf. Services include distributor
management, local promotions, and organizing trade events. This approach enhances visibility and
builds partnerships essential for sustainable growth.

#### [Distributor Management][34]

Working with the right distributors is critical for success. CODADA specializes in finding
distributors, building relationships, and managing performance. Support covers every stage, from
selection to long-term alignment with business goals. A well-managed distribution network ensures
efficient market coverage.

#### [Business Development][35]

Growth requires the right strategy and connections. Services focus on identifying new business
opportunities and building partnerships. Expertise in market entry and expansion ensures tailored
solutions for sustainable success. Support includes finding importers and distributors to strengthen
market presence.

#### [Import/Export Advisory][36]

Efficient import and export processes are essential for market entry. The team provides guidance on
regulations, licenses, certifications (e.g., Halal and FDA) and proper documentation. Every step is
designed to simplify trade operations. Businesses benefit from streamlined processes and full
compliance, ensuring success in new markets.

#### [Market Research, Insights & Reporting][37]

Understanding the market is key to growth. Services include analyzing trends, consumer behavior, and
competitor activities. The focus is on delivering insights that support better decisions and
long-term planning. Research helps identify opportunities and guides businesses in finding importers
and distributors for effective market entry.

## Why Us

CODADA supports FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, and personal care businesses with market entry and
distributor management.

With over 20 years of experience, we help companies achieve sustainable business growth.

Our team combines deep market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

01

#### Comprehensive Services

Services focus on finding importers and distributors, ensuring successful market entry, and
establishing trade and market representation. Additional support includes import/export Advisory,
distributor management, and market research. Each solution is tailored to address specific business
needs, ensuring smooth entry and long-term growth. Detailed reporting and continuous support help
businesses adapt to competitive markets and thrive.


02

#### Proven Expertise

With over 20 years of experience in the FMCG, food, and beverage industry, CODADA provides unmatched
expertise. The team’s understanding of local cultures, regulations, and business practices ensures
challenges are overcome, and opportunities are maximized. This extensive experience allows CODADA to
anticipate market trends and adapt strategies proactively. Clients benefit from a hands-on approach
that combines global insights with local knowledge to drive measurable results.

03

#### Strategic Locations

With offices in Asia, Europe, and the Americas, CODADA provides access to key markets across Asia,
Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. This global presence ensures timely support and tailored
strategies for each region. The multi-location advantage enables seamless market entry and sustained
growth for businesses worldwide. Proximity to key markets allows for quicker decision-making and
more effective market engagement. This structure ensures businesses remain competitive in dynamic
global markets.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below you will find answers to common questions about our services and expertise.
If you require further information, please do not hesitate to [contact us][38].
* [What services does CODADA offer? ][39]
  
  CODADA offers a comprehensive suite of services, including market and trade representation, market
  research, distributor management, business development, and product and sales training. For more
  details, please visit our [services section][40].
* [Which markets does CODADA specialize in? ][41]
  
  We specialize in markets across South-East Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
  **•** Middle East: Bahrain, Iraq (North), Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia,
  United Arab Emirates (UAE)
  **•** South-East-Asia: Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore,
  Thailand, Vietnam
  **•** East-Asia: China, Hong Kong & Macau, Japan, Korea, Taiwan
* [What is the process for initiating a collaboration with CODADA? ][42]
  
  To initiate a collaboration with CODADA, please contact us via our contact form, email, or phone.
  Our team will engage with you to discuss your specific needs and tailor our services to meet your
  market expansion goals. Get in touch with us through our [contact page][43].
* [What makes CODADA different from other market expansion services? ][44]
  
  CODADA's extensive experience, strategic location, and comprehensive service offerings set us
  apart. Our deep understanding of local markets and personalized approach ensures that we provide
  effective solutions tailored to each client's unique needs. Learn more about us in the [about
  section][45].
* [Do you provide support for regulatory compliance? ][46]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides specialized advice on navigating regulatory requirements, including obtaining
  necessary licenses such as Halal and FDA, and handling documentation to ensure smooth and
  compliant transactions.
* [Does CODADA provide assistance with trade shows and exhibitions? ][47]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides comprehensive assistance with trade shows and exhibitions as part of our
  market and trade representation services. We organize and conduct these events to effectively
  promote your products and brands within the target markets.
* [What are the costs associated with your services? ][48]
  
  The costs associated with our services vary depending on the specific requirements and scope of
  each project. CODADA offers tailored solutions to meet your business objectives and market
  expansion needs. For a detailed quote, please contact us directly to discuss your requirements and
  receive a customized proposal. Reach out to us through our [contact form][49].
* [Who are your primary clients? ][50]
  
  Our primary clients are principal companies, including producers and brand owners in the FMCG,
  food & beverage and related industries, who seek to establish or enhance their trade and market
  presence in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe without the need to build and maintain their own
  physical presence. We specialize in helping businesses expand their reach and succeed in these
  dynamic markets by providing comprehensive consulting services, strategic insights, and
  on-the-ground representation.

Partner with CODADA and take the next step towards your business success.

Contact us today to discuss how CODADA can help you achieve your market expansion goals.

## CODADA: Partner in Market Expansion

CODADA helps businesses in **FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, and personal care** to **find
importers**, **find distributors**, succeed with **market entry** and ongoing **distributor
management** in **Europe, Asia and the Middle East**. With over **20 years of experience**, we
provide **expert support** to grow your market presence and thrive in these **fast-growing
regions**.

#### Client-Centered Approach

CODADA starts with the client’s product, target channels, pricing structure, and market objectives.
This helps define a practical market entry route before approaching importers, distributors,
retailers, or other market partners. The result is a clearer starting point for market discussions
and partner selection.

#### In-Market Expertise

Our work combines experience in FMCG, food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and consumer
goods with practical market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. This allows clients
to receive support that is commercially grounded and relevant to each market.

#### From Search to Follow-Up

The services include more than just finding importers or distributors. Our work covers market entry
preparation, partner qualification, communication, distributor management, market feedback, and
ongoing in-market support. This helps clients move from partner search to active market development.

#### Long-Term Development

CODADA helps clients build sustainable market presence through suitable partners, structured
follow-up, realistic market development, and long-term commercial progress. This helps turn early
market interest into practical next steps and ongoing business development.

## Services

CODADA supports businesses with **market entry, distributor search, and ongoing distributor
management** across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

We help companies **find distributors**, **identify importers**, and manage **local partnerships**
for sustainable growth in FMCG, F&B, cosmetics, personal care, and retail.

Our expertise includes guiding Western companies into Asian and Middle Eastern markets—through both
**B2B and B2C** channels.

We also support **Asian businesses expanding into Europe** and other international markets.

Each service is tailored to your needs, ensuring **smooth market entry** and **long-term success**.

#### [Market Entry][32]

CODADA supports structured market entry into Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. We help you find the
right partners, navigate compliance, and manage local follow-up - ensuring faster access and
long-term success across FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and retail sectors.

#### [Market & Trade Representation][33]

Establishing a strong presence in local markets can be challenging. CODADA represents products,
brands, and companies in Asia and the Middle East on their behalf. Services include distributor
management, local promotions, and organizing trade events. This approach enhances visibility and
builds partnerships essential for sustainable growth.

#### [Distributor Management][34]

Working with the right distributors is critical for success. CODADA specializes in finding
distributors, building relationships, and managing performance. Support covers every stage, from
selection to long-term alignment with business goals. A well-managed distribution network ensures
efficient market coverage.

#### [Business Development][35]

Growth requires the right strategy and connections. Services focus on identifying new business
opportunities and building partnerships. Expertise in market entry and expansion ensures tailored
solutions for sustainable success. Support includes finding importers and distributors to strengthen
market presence.

#### [Import/Export Advisory][36]

Efficient import and export processes are essential for market entry. The team provides guidance on
regulations, licenses, certifications (e.g., Halal and FDA) and proper documentation. Every step is
designed to simplify trade operations. Businesses benefit from streamlined processes and full
compliance, ensuring success in new markets.

#### [Market Research, Insights & Reporting][37]

Understanding the market is key to growth. Services include analyzing trends, consumer behavior, and
competitor activities. The focus is on delivering insights that support better decisions and
long-term planning. Research helps identify opportunities and guides businesses in finding importers
and distributors for effective market entry.

## Why Us

CODADA supports FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, and personal care businesses with market entry and
distributor management.

With over 20 years of experience, we help companies achieve sustainable business growth.

Our team combines deep market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

01

#### Comprehensive Services

Services focus on finding importers and distributors, ensuring successful market entry, and
establishing trade and market representation. Additional support includes import/export Advisory,
distributor management, and market research. Each solution is tailored to address specific business
needs, ensuring smooth entry and long-term growth. Detailed reporting and continuous support help
businesses adapt to competitive markets and thrive.


02

#### Proven Expertise

With over 20 years of experience in the FMCG, food, and beverage industry, CODADA provides unmatched
expertise. The team’s understanding of local cultures, regulations, and business practices ensures
challenges are overcome, and opportunities are maximized. This extensive experience allows CODADA to
anticipate market trends and adapt strategies proactively. Clients benefit from a hands-on approach
that combines global insights with local knowledge to drive measurable results.

03

#### Strategic Locations

With offices in Asia, Europe, and the Americas, CODADA provides access to key markets across Asia,
Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. This global presence ensures timely support and tailored
strategies for each region. The multi-location advantage enables seamless market entry and sustained
growth for businesses worldwide. Proximity to key markets allows for quicker decision-making and
more effective market engagement. This structure ensures businesses remain competitive in dynamic
global markets.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below you will find answers to common questions about our services and expertise.
If you require further information, please do not hesitate to [contact us][38].
* [What services does CODADA offer? ][39]
  
  CODADA offers a comprehensive suite of services, including market and trade representation, market
  research, distributor management, business development, and product and sales training. For more
  details, please visit our [services section][40].
* [Which markets does CODADA specialize in? ][41]
  
  We specialize in markets across South-East Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
  **•** Middle East: Bahrain, Iraq (North), Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia,
  United Arab Emirates (UAE)
  **•** South-East-Asia: Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore,
  Thailand, Vietnam
  **•** East-Asia: China, Hong Kong & Macau, Japan, Korea, Taiwan
* [What is the process for initiating a collaboration with CODADA? ][42]
  
  To initiate a collaboration with CODADA, please contact us via our contact form, email, or phone.
  Our team will engage with you to discuss your specific needs and tailor our services to meet your
  market expansion goals. Get in touch with us through our [contact page][43].
* [What makes CODADA different from other market expansion services? ][44]
  
  CODADA's extensive experience, strategic location, and comprehensive service offerings set us
  apart. Our deep understanding of local markets and personalized approach ensures that we provide
  effective solutions tailored to each client's unique needs. Learn more about us in the [about
  section][45].
* [Do you provide support for regulatory compliance? ][46]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides specialized advice on navigating regulatory requirements, including obtaining
  necessary licenses such as Halal and FDA, and handling documentation to ensure smooth and
  compliant transactions.
* [Does CODADA provide assistance with trade shows and exhibitions? ][47]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides comprehensive assistance with trade shows and exhibitions as part of our
  market and trade representation services. We organize and conduct these events to effectively
  promote your products and brands within the target markets.
* [What are the costs associated with your services? ][48]
  
  The costs associated with our services vary depending on the specific requirements and scope of
  each project. CODADA offers tailored solutions to meet your business objectives and market
  expansion needs. For a detailed quote, please contact us directly to discuss your requirements and
  receive a customized proposal. Reach out to us through our [contact form][49].
* [Who are your primary clients? ][50]
  
  Our primary clients are principal companies, including producers and brand owners in the FMCG,
  food & beverage and related industries, who seek to establish or enhance their trade and market
  presence in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe without the need to build and maintain their own
  physical presence. We specialize in helping businesses expand their reach and succeed in these
  dynamic markets by providing comprehensive consulting services, strategic insights, and
  on-the-ground representation.

## Delivering North America’s First Purpose-Built Medical Isotope Reactor

###### Introduction

## Before

Until recently, nuclear medicine focused exclusively on **diagnostics and limited
radiopharmaceutical therapy treatments.**

## Today Forward

But now, breakthroughs in novel, cancer-targeting radiotherapeutics are **driving a precision
medicine revolution.**

#### Challenges

Radioisotope supply can’t keep pace with medical innovation or projected demand.
No large-scale domestic production in North America. The U.S. depends on insecure global supply
chains and aging, inefficient foreign reactors.

#### SolutionS

**Eden Radioisotopes **– Privately held U.S. medical isotope producer.

Developing on-shore, purpose-built reactor for isotope production.

Low energy use, high output, and cost-efficient tech ensures secure, sustainable supply.

Positioned to strengthen U.S. medical infrastructure and support the future of precision medicine.

## NEED

> Medical care in this country for cancer, heart disease, and bone scans simply cannot be held

> 
> - Rep. Edward J. Markey, U.S. House of Representatives (hearing remarks)

[ Learn More ][41]

## Delivering North America’s First Purpose-Built Medical Isotope Reactor

###### Introduction

## Before

Until recently, nuclear medicine focused exclusively on **diagnostics and limited
radiopharmaceutical therapy treatments.**

## Today Forward

But now, breakthroughs in novel, cancer-targeting radiotherapeutics are **driving a precision
medicine revolution.**

#### Challenges

Radioisotope supply can’t keep pace with medical innovation or projected demand.
No large-scale domestic production in North America. The U.S. depends on insecure global supply
chains and aging, inefficient foreign reactors.

#### SolutionS

**Eden Radioisotopes **– Privately held U.S. medical isotope producer.

Developing on-shore, purpose-built reactor for isotope production.

Low energy use, high output, and cost-efficient tech ensures secure, sustainable supply.

Positioned to strengthen U.S. medical infrastructure and support the future of precision medicine.

## Who we are?

Finecert is the business unit of Fineleaps Technology Pvt, Ltd. Finecert has grown into one of the
leading global company for International Management solutions like ISO Certification and Consulting
services for 30+ ISO Standards mainly ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001 etc. We also assist companies
with SOC2, PCI DSS and GDPR requirements.

Finecert is now offering its ISO certification and Consulting services in various parts of the globe
with an international footprint in Middle East, Africa, and Asian countries like [Oman][183],
[Qatar][184], [Kuwait][185], [Bahrain][186], [U.A.E][187], [Saudi Arabia][188], [Jordan][189],

improvement.

[WHO-WE-ARE]

## Our Policy

Finecert is committed to provide impeccable quality of service to its customers. In order to achieve
this, we believe in providing consulting and certification services as not just business, but a
partnership approach. Building and sustaining a positive and supportive relationship with our
clients is the heart of our working principle. We continuously strive to improve processes &
services to exceed customer satisfaction at all times. The implementation of the quality policy is
the responsibility of all staff, including the Board members. Finecert aims to deliver reliable,
cost-effective solutions to organizations across all industries. Our pricing transparency ensures
that there are no hidden extra costs. Our quotes give prospective clients a clear breakdown of what
they paying for, so we follow No certification, no fees policy.

[Our-Policy]

and consulting services for 30+ International Standards like [ISO 9001][208],[ ISO 13485][209], [ISO

Finecert specializes in providing consulting & conducting ISO and related certification audit

EMPLOYEE LEASING

## Hire employees in 50+ countries without needing a local entity

Employee Leasing enables clients to hire employees in countries without the need to operate a local
legal entity there. We hire employees on your behalf (Employer of Record) and handle payroll, taxes,
and employee benefits. We also ensure compliance with local laws. Without this burden, you can fully
concentrate on your core business.

With 25 years of experience navigating foreign markets, we understand the unique needs of our
clients.

Our passion for providing exceptional support and consulting is at the heart of everything we do,
and it’s why our clients trust us.

HOW IT WORKS

## Hire your own employees abroad
## without a local entity

**1. Consultation:
**Schedule a free call with us**, **we will guide you through the entire process.

**2. Talent Selection:
**Select your own candidate or utilize our recruitment services, available in multiple countries.

**3. Planning Meeting:
**We will discuss salary, benefits, contract options, and answer all your questions.

**4. Onboarding & Administration:
**We hire the employee locally with the salary and conditions you have defined. We manage all HR
administration, including contracts, payroll, taxes, and social security, ensuring full compliance.

**5. Employee Management:
**Our clients stay in the functional control of the employees.

EMPLOYEE LEASING

## Hire employees in 50+ countries without needing a local entity

Employee Leasing enables clients to hire employees in countries without the need to operate a local
legal entity there. We hire employees on your behalf (Employer of Record) and handle payroll, taxes,
and employee benefits. We also ensure compliance with local laws. Without this burden, you can fully
concentrate on your core business.

With 25 years of experience navigating foreign markets, we understand the unique needs of our
clients.

Our passion for providing exceptional support and consulting is at the heart of everything we do,
and it’s why our clients trust us.

[ Browse Countries ][203]
[ Contact Us ][204]

HOW IT WORKS

## Hire your own employees abroad
## without a local entity

**1. Consultation:
**Schedule a free call with us**, **we will guide you through the entire process.

**2. Talent Selection:
**Select your own candidate or utilize our recruitment services, available in multiple countries.

**3. Planning Meeting:
**We will discuss salary, benefits, contract options, and answer all your questions.

**4. Onboarding & Administration:
**We hire the employee locally with the salary and conditions you have defined. We manage all HR
administration, including contracts, payroll, taxes, and social security, ensuring full compliance.

**5. Employee Management:
**Our clients stay in the functional control of the employees.

## neom

# The Line

City of the Future in Saudi Arabia

## What is the Line

[According][18] to sources familiar with the situation, Prince Mohammed, chairman of the NEOM
Development Agency, now sees the project on a significantly ‘smaller scale.’ This indicates that the
Riyadh authorities recognise the shortcomings of the initial, extremely ambitious concept, as well
as mistakes made in the early stages of construction.

The NEOM territory stretches along the Red Sea coast and covers an area comparable in size to
Belgium. Its central element, the 170-kilometre city of The Line, will be radically reduced.
According to sources, NEOM may now be refocused on creating a hub for data centres as part of Prince
Mohammed’s drive to turn the kingdom into a global leader in artificial intelligence.

The changes come amid Riyadh’s efforts to control public finances amid declining liquidity after a
decade of massive spending and subdued oil prices. At the same time, Saudi Arabia faces tight
deadlines and high costs in preparing to host the Expo international exhibition in 2030 and the
World Cup in 2034.

Rendering of the horizontal skyscraper «The Line» / © NEOM

Riyadh announced that the Trojena project, which will also be scaled back, will no longer host the
Asian Winter Games as planned. According to the source, architects are already working on reworking
the Mirror Line concept, which had already been significantly scaled back, to create a more «modest»
version using infrastructure already built in recent years.

The NEOM project comprises several key regions, each with a unique purpose, from industrial and
business hub to tourist resort:

### [Magna][19]

This NEOM region, focused on eco-tourism and the preservation of natural landscapes and cultural
heritage. In Magna it is planned to develop sustainable tourism combining natural beauty with
archaeological sites.

### Sindalah

An island resort with luxury hotels, yachting infrastructure and high-end entertainment. The island
will become a major destination for yachtsmen and upscale tourism.

### Trojena

Mountainous resort region offering winter sports and ecotourism. Includes artificial lakes and ski
slopes, despite the desert surroundings.

### Oxagon

An octagonal industrial and port city on the Red Sea coast. Much of the city will be built on water,
making it the largest floating industrial complex in the world.

#### are always a pleasure to work with.”

Jane Miller

## neom

# The Line

City of the Future in Saudi Arabia

## What is the Line

[According][18] to sources familiar with the situation, Prince Mohammed, chairman of the NEOM
Development Agency, now sees the project on a significantly ‘smaller scale.’ This indicates that the
Riyadh authorities recognise the shortcomings of the initial, extremely ambitious concept, as well
as mistakes made in the early stages of construction.

The NEOM territory stretches along the Red Sea coast and covers an area comparable in size to
Belgium. Its central element, the 170-kilometre city of The Line, will be radically reduced.
According to sources, NEOM may now be refocused on creating a hub for data centres as part of Prince
Mohammed’s drive to turn the kingdom into a global leader in artificial intelligence.

The changes come amid Riyadh’s efforts to control public finances amid declining liquidity after a
decade of massive spending and subdued oil prices. At the same time, Saudi Arabia faces tight
deadlines and high costs in preparing to host the Expo international exhibition in 2030 and the
World Cup in 2034.

Rendering of the horizontal skyscraper «The Line» / © NEOM

Riyadh announced that the Trojena project, which will also be scaled back, will no longer host the
Asian Winter Games as planned. According to the source, architects are already working on reworking
the Mirror Line concept, which had already been significantly scaled back, to create a more «modest»
version using infrastructure already built in recent years.

The NEOM project comprises several key regions, each with a unique purpose, from industrial and
business hub to tourist resort:

### [Magna][19]

This NEOM region, focused on eco-tourism and the preservation of natural landscapes and cultural
heritage. In Magna it is planned to develop sustainable tourism combining natural beauty with
archaeological sites.

### Sindalah

An island resort with luxury hotels, yachting infrastructure and high-end entertainment. The island
will become a major destination for yachtsmen and upscale tourism.

### Trojena

Mountainous resort region offering winter sports and ecotourism. Includes artificial lakes and ski
slopes, despite the desert surroundings.

### Oxagon

An octagonal industrial and port city on the Red Sea coast. Much of the city will be built on water,
making it the largest floating industrial complex in the world.

#### About Us

#### Welcome to MK Science Set Publishers: Your Gateway to Cutting-Edge Scientific Exploration

In the dynamic realm of scientific exploration, MK Science Set Publishers stands tall as a beacon of
innovation and excellence. As independent international scientific peer-reviewed clinical and
medical journal publishers, we take immense pride in our role as trailblazers, fostering a culture
of knowledge dissemination and collaboration on a global scale.

**Diversity Across Disciplines:** At MK Science Set Publishers, our commitment to advancing
scientific knowledge knows no bounds. With a focus on diverse subject areas such as Clinical,
Medical, Pharma, Biomedical, Life Sciences, Engineering, and Environmental studies, our online
journals encompass a vast array of content types. From in-depth research articles to
thought-provoking opinion pieces, our publications span the breadth and depth of scientific inquiry,
providing a comprehensive resource for scholars, researchers, and enthusiasts alike.

**Unrivaled Peer-Review Process:** What sets us apart as the best open access journal article
publishers is our unwavering dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality. Every piece
of content that graces our journals undergoes a meticulous peer-review process, ensuring that it not
only meets but exceeds the benchmarks of excellence. We take pride in being a trusted source for
rigorously reviewed research, review articles, case reports, and much more.



**Meet Our Team:** Behind the success of MK Science Set Publishers is a team of exceptional
individuals. Our community and advisory board members are not just professionals; they are
visionaries in their respective fields. With diverse expertise and a shared commitment to advancing
knowledge, our team plays a crucial role in discovering and developing new avenues for research and
development within our organization.

**A Vision for Knowledge Sharing:** As we journey forward, MK Science Set Publishers is guided by a
compelling vision — to develop an optimized knowledge-sharing platform and an enlightening
interactive network for researchers across the globe. This vision is not merely aspirational; it's a
strategic commitment to creating an environment where ideas flourish, collaborations thrive, and the
global scientific community evolves collectively.

**Optimized Knowledge-Sharing Platform:** Central to our vision is the creation of a cutting-edge
knowledge-sharing platform. This platform transcends the traditional boundaries of academic
publishing, incorporating innovative features designed to facilitate seamless collaboration,
interdisciplinary interactions, and real-time engagement. Researchers from diverse backgrounds
converge on our platform to contribute to and benefit from a collective pool of knowledge, thereby
propelling the wheels of scientific progress forward.

**Enlightening Interactive Network:** In our pursuit of excellence, MK Science Set Publishers
envisions a future where researchers worldwide are seamlessly connected in an enlightening
interactive network. Through our scientific publications and meetings, we are not only disseminating
knowledge but also fostering an environment where ideas transcend borders, collaboration knows no
limits, and the global scientific community thrives as one interconnected entity.

**Embarking on a Journey of Discovery:** As you explore the world of MK Science Set Publishers,
you're not just engaging with a publisher; you're embarking on a journey of discovery. We invite you
to join us as we redefine the landscape of knowledge dissemination, making science accessible,
collaborative, and impactful for all.

In every article we publish, every meeting we convene, and every interaction we facilitate, MK
Science Set Publishers is committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific integrity and
contributing to the advancement of knowledge that benefits humanity. Join us in this exciting
endeavor, where innovation meets excellence in scientific publishing.

# A Journey Through Modern Physics

 

Welcome to the world of modern physics, a fascinating branch of science that guides us into the
deepest secrets of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature. From the discoveries of quantum
mechanics to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, modern physics continues to surprise us and
advance our understanding of the universe and the reality around us. By combining mathematics,
experiments, and incredible intuition, we explore the structure of matter, the universe, and time
itself. Join us on a journey of discovery and discover how modern physics moves us forward in our
exploration of the foundations of existence.

Modern Physics is a website dedicated to providing information about the latest discoveries,
theories, and research in the field of physics. It covers topics such as quantum mechanics,
relativity, electromagnetism, optics, and other key areas of modern physics. The goal of the site is
to share engaging articles, news, and educational materials that illuminate complex physics concepts
for the general public and open up discussion about how modern physics shapes our understanding of
the universe and the reality around us.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

### Mechanics

Enter a world of motion and force where we encounter the rules that govern the matter around us.
Mechanics allows us to understand how bodies move and what forces act on them, from planets orbiting
stars to the smallest particles in space.

### Thermodynamics

relativity and the search for a theory of everything. Modern physics opens the door to the unknown,
where our understanding of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature is constantly expanding
and changing.

revolutionary electronic devices. It’s the science that transforms theoretical knowledge into
real-world applications, enhancing our everyday lives.

# A Journey Through Modern Physics

 

Welcome to the world of modern physics, a fascinating branch of science that guides us into the
deepest secrets of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature. From the discoveries of quantum
mechanics to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, modern physics continues to surprise us and
advance our understanding of the universe and the reality around us. By combining mathematics,
experiments, and incredible intuition, we explore the structure of matter, the universe, and time
itself. Join us on a journey of discovery and discover how modern physics moves us forward in our
exploration of the foundations of existence.

Modern Physics is a website dedicated to providing information about the latest discoveries,
theories, and research in the field of physics. It covers topics such as quantum mechanics,
relativity, electromagnetism, optics, and other key areas of modern physics. The goal of the site is
to share engaging articles, news, and educational materials that illuminate complex physics concepts
for the general public and open up discussion about how modern physics shapes our understanding of
the universe and the reality around us.

## Open for business

Operating 24/7 with expanded operations, Port of NEOM is facilitating trade across northwest Saudi
Arabia and strengthening connectivity through intermodal corridors linking Egypt, the region, and
Europe. 

As the Port expands with an advanced container terminal and deeper integration with Oxagon’s
industrial ecosystem, emerging as a gateway for Saudi Arabia’s maritime and trade ambitions.

At NRD we’ve been putting safe, effective alpha-energy to work for our customers since 1969. We’re
the world’s largest, and one of the most experienced, manufacturers of ion sources. With a full line
of products that use ion sources for static control, smoke detection, physics research and
instrumentation. In addition to our standard line of products, we produce custom polonium 210,

[Energy][32]

# physics powering futures

At Nusano, we don’t rewrite the laws of physics. We use physics to rewrite possibilities.

Nusano is committed to bringing stability and innovation to the rapidly emerging and critically
undersupplied medical radioisotopes market.

We’ve developed a process that is more efficient than existing technologies to reliably produce
radioisotopes at the heart of next-generation cancer treatments and diagnosis techniques.

Radioisotopes are essential components in the active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) of a category
of new and emerging cancer therapies, known as radiotherapeutics. Existing supply chains for these
treatment-enabling resources are often strained, posing a risk to patient care, clinical trials, and
ongoing drug development.

Nusano’s role in the health care ecosystem is as a supplier of medical radioisotopes to drugmakers,
hospitals and clinics. With a reliable supply of radioisotopes, these teams can then formulate
treatments and next-generation pharmaceuticals needed to advance the fight against cancer.

TECHNOLOGY

###  A new way to produce radioisotopes

Radioisotopes have been used in healthcare and industrial applications for decades. But today, the
supply often doesn’t meet the need. That’s where Nusano comes in. Nusano is combining time-tested
methods with our own breakthrough, patented particle acceleration technology, so we can produce
radioisotopes quickly, efficiently, and affordably. Together with industry leaders, Nusano is
working to supply and enable multiple billion-dollar industries to improve the quality of life for
people around the world. 

[BREAKTHROUGHS][33]
[Supporting radioisotope production and research]
[Nusano radioisotope production campus in West Valley City, Utah]

PRODUCTION

### WEST VALLEY CITY, UTAH

Nusano is building a state-of-the-art production facility in Utah’s Salt Lake Valley. It will not
only create radioisotopes needed by health care, industry and researchers, but also bring new,
high-tech jobs to the area.

[UTAH][34]

PURPOSE

### Discover what drives us

The people of Nusano are working to empower the world’s leading companies, health care providers,
and innovators with the radioisotopes needed to advance cancer care, support modern operations, and
create sustainable energy solutions.

### [Accelerating Energy Solutions][31]

Nusano’s technologies are capable of producing HALEU fuel for next-generation energy platforms and
powering advanced batteries

[Energy][32]

# physics powering futures

At Nusano, we don’t rewrite the laws of physics. We use physics to rewrite possibilities.

Nusano is committed to bringing stability and innovation to the rapidly emerging and critically
undersupplied medical radioisotopes market.

We’ve developed a process that is more efficient than existing technologies to reliably produce
radioisotopes at the heart of next-generation cancer treatments and diagnosis techniques.

Radioisotopes are essential components in the active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) of a category
of new and emerging cancer therapies, known as radiotherapeutics. Existing supply chains for these
treatment-enabling resources are often strained, posing a risk to patient care, clinical trials, and
ongoing drug development.

Nusano’s role in the health care ecosystem is as a supplier of medical radioisotopes to drugmakers,
hospitals and clinics. With a reliable supply of radioisotopes, these teams can then formulate
treatments and next-generation pharmaceuticals needed to advance the fight against cancer.

TECHNOLOGY

###  A new way to produce radioisotopes

Radioisotopes have been used in healthcare and industrial applications for decades. But today, the
supply often doesn’t meet the need. That’s where Nusano comes in. Nusano is combining time-tested
methods with our own breakthrough, patented particle acceleration technology, so we can produce
radioisotopes quickly, efficiently, and affordably. Together with industry leaders, Nusano is
working to supply and enable multiple billion-dollar industries to improve the quality of life for
people around the world. 

[BREAKTHROUGHS][33]

PRODUCTION

### WEST VALLEY CITY, UTAH

Nusano is building a state-of-the-art production facility in Utah’s Salt Lake Valley. It will not
only create radioisotopes needed by health care, industry and researchers, but also bring new,
high-tech jobs to the area.

[UTAH][34]

PURPOSE

### Discover what drives us

The people of Nusano are working to empower the world’s leading companies, health care providers,
and innovators with the radioisotopes needed to advance cancer care, support modern operations, and
create sustainable energy solutions.

# Healthcare Science Hubs

### Overview

Open MedScience is a structured healthcare science publishing platform organised around thematic
hubs in medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health and wellbeing.

### Expertise

Our thematic hubs provide interdisciplinary analysis across medical imaging, nuclear medicine,
public health and healthcare policy.

### Discovery

OpenMedAI enhances discovery by guiding readers across the hubs and connecting them directly to the
relevant content.

[[Imaging Modalities Hub presents a comprehensive overview of diagnostic imaging technologies]][16]

## **Imaging Modalities Hub**

Explore the Imaging Modalities Hub to gain a structured overview of diagnostic imaging technologies,
including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and nuclear imaging. This hub explains how these modalities
support diagnosis, monitoring and treatment planning across the clinical practice.

[[Targeted therapy radiopharmaceuticals deliver precision treatment, improve outcomes, minimise
toxicity]][17]

## **Nuclear Therapeutics** **Hub **

The Nuclear Therapeutics Hub examines radiopharmaceutical science and targeted radionuclide
therapies in modern nuclear medicine. This hub evaluates tracer chemistry, radiolabelling,
dosimetry, regulatory science and clinical translation in the area of oncology.

[[Medical imaging improves diagnosis, guides treatment, supports monitoring, enhances
patient-centred clinical decision-making]][18]

## **Clinical Imaging Hub**

The Clinical Imaging Hub bridges diagnostic imaging with everyday clinical practice. Find out how
this hub integrates radiology, nuclear medicine, radiation therapy and medical physics, supporting
training, safety standards and research.

[[Digital Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions][Digital
Health Hub integrates data, improves care, enables smarter clinical decisions]][19]

## **Digital Health Hub**

The Digital Health Hub explores technologies transforming healthcare delivery and imaging workflows.
This hub covers artificial intelligence, robotics, cybersecurity and digital infrastructure,
emphasising implementation, optimisation and secure data management.

[[Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes][Medical Research Hub accelerates discovery, supports collaboration, improves translational
outcomes]][20]

## **Medical Research Hub**

The Medical Research Hub focuses on research quality, governance and clinical translation. Explore
how it connects reproducible methods, regulatory science, and publishing standards to support
responsible innovation and healthcare implementation.

[[Health and medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life][Health and
medicine advance wellbeing, prevent disease, improve global quality-of-life]][21]

## **Wellbeing Hub **

The Wellbeing Hub examines medicine, public health and prevention within social and policy contexts.
This hub explores how systems, behaviour and environment influence long-term health outcomes and
community resilience.

[[Explore medical imaging through research, innovation and clinical insight][Explore medical imaging
through research, innovation and clinical insight]][22]

## **Explore**

Open MedScience delivers in-depth coverage of medical imaging, from foundational science to clinical
application. Examine technological progress, artificial intelligence and multidisciplinary practice
shaping modern healthcare.

[[Learn healthcare science through structured insight and expert guidance][Learn healthcare science
through structured insight and expert guidance]][23]

## **Learn **

Advance your professional knowledge through structured insight across healthcare science. Explore
medical physics, radiopharmaceutical science, digital health and translational medicine within a
responsible clinical framework.

[[Contribute a blog article advancing imaging and healthcare science][Contribute a blog article
advancing imaging and healthcare science]][24]

## Contribute

Submit a blog article sharing original research, clinical translation or technology innovation.
Contribute editorial insight, education or health and wellbeing perspectives. Join a collaborative
community advancing imaging and digital health responsibly.

[Medical Robotics][26]

Pentagon officials have consistently dismissed the pizza theory, emphasizing both the lack of

The Pentagon Pizza Index expanded beyond pizza monitoring to include gay bars near sensitive
government facilities. The theory suggests that unusually quiet activity at LGBTQ+ establishments
during peak hours may indicate personnel working overtime on classified operations, as military and
intelligence staff avoid public venues during high-tempo periods.

[Queerty reported][24] on how this iconic gay bar near the Pentagon became part of open-source
intelligence tracking, with observers noting correlations between quiet nights at establishments
like Freddie's Beach Bar and subsequent military developments in the Middle East.

The gay bar theory operates on an inverse correlation principle: when establishments that typically
see consistent evening traffic suddenly become quiet, it may signal that government personnel are
working extended hours on sensitive matters.

Observers track venues like Freddie's Beach Bar (1.4 mi from Pentagon) and The Little Gay Pub (1.1
mi from White House), monitoring for unusual dips in activity that coincide with geopolitical
tensions.

[Gay Bar Intelligence Monitoring - OSINT Activity Tracking]

Gentlemen's Dispatch extends the same open-source pattern logic to strip-club activity around
military communities. The premise is simple: unusual nightlife swings can act as an early signal of
deployment tempo and readiness changes.

A recent [New York Post report][25] describes troops discussing upcoming deployments with a dancer,
adding public anecdotal evidence to the broader OPSEC-signal conversation.

It's an OSINT signal supported by historical anecdotes and modern traffic data. Spikes frequently
coincide with elevated watch or major news. Like any single indicator, it's best read in context
with other signals.

### How do I read the dashboard and DOUGHCON levels?

Watch the DOUGHCON display, active spikes, and the overall index. Look for "Busier than usual"

How pizza delivery patterns became a window into military operations and global events.

1970s

### 1970s-1980s: SOVIET "PIZZINT" DOCTRINE

Soviet intelligence operatives develop unconventional surveillance methodology targeting Washington
D.C.'s late-night food delivery patterns. KGB codename: "PIZZINT" (Pizza Intelligence).

Operational Logic:

"If lights were burning late at the Pentagon or CIA, and delivery couriers were hauling stacks of
pizzas through the door, something big might be brewing behind closed doors."

Strategic Rationale:

"When U.S. military and intelligence staff worked late into the night during emergencies, they would
order large quantities of food—especially pizza—since it is quick and convenient. A spike in pizza
orders could signal that something significant was happening behind closed doors."

[Soviet PIZZINT Intelligence Operation Illustration]
1983

### 1983-1989: PATTERN VALIDATION PHASE

Local pizza delivery drivers began noticing they could anticipate "big news" 72 hours in advance by
upticks in orders to government buildings. The pattern held across multiple military operations, as
documented by [TIME magazine in 1990][19].

Original Testimony

"We know. Absolutely. Pentagon orders doubled up the night before the Panama attack; same thing
happened before the Grenada invasion. Last Wednesday, we got a lot of orders, starting around
midnight. We figured something was up."

— Domino's Pizza Runner, TIME Magazine, August 13, 1990

#### ✓ GRENADA (1983)

Pentagon orders doubled the night before Operation Urgent Fury

#### ✓ PANAMA (1989)

Same pattern observed before Operation Just Cause

[Pattern Validation Intelligence Operation - Grenada and Panama]
AUG '90

### AUG 1990 - JAN 1991: GULF WAR DOCUMENTATION

The most celebrated case came during the Gulf Crisis. Frank Meeks, owner of 43 D.C. Domino's
franchises, [documented unprecedented late-night deliveries][20] as U.S. forces prepared to expel
Iraqi troops from Kuwait.

Recorded Data[(source)][21]
101 pizzasdelivered to Pentagon on Jan 15, 1991
21 pizzasto CIA on Aug 1, 1990 (night before Kuwait invasion)
3 → 100+Pentagon orders jumped in 8 days
CNN
Wolf Blitzer, CNN Pentagon Correspondent

"Bottom line for journalists: Always monitor the pizzas."

[Gulf War Pizza Intelligence Documentation - Pentagon and Kuwait Operations]
2023

### 2023-2024: DIGITAL RENAISSANCE

With Google Maps "Popular Times" showing live customer traffic, digital sleuths realized they could
virtually monitor Pentagon-area pizzerias in real time. The Pizza Index exploded across social media
during the 2023-24 Israel-Hamas conflict.

#### 📱 APRIL 13, 2024

Iran launches drones → Papa John's shows "Busier than usual" → Viral on X/Twitter

#### 🚀 JUNE 12, 2025

@PenPizzaReport detects surge at 6:59 PM → Israel strikes Iran at 7:00 PM. [FOX News coverage][22]
detailed the pizza tracking phenomenon.

Digital Innovation

Real-time Google Maps data transforms pizza delivery monitoring from physical surveillance to
virtual intelligence gathering.

[Digital Renaissance - OSINT Pizza Intelligence Workstation]
JUN '25

### JUNE 2025: OFFICIAL RESPONSE

Pentagon officials have consistently dismissed the pizza theory, emphasizing both the lack of
correlation between pizza order spikes and military events and the abundance of food options within
the Pentagon itself. The theory has gained renewed attention through [extensive media coverage][23]
during recent geopolitical events.

DOD

#### Department of Defense Statement

When reached for comment on the Pentagon Pizza Report's June 12 post and the pizza theory, the
Department of Defense (DOD) told FOX Business it has "nothing to offer" on the matter.

[Pentagon Official Response - No Correlation Detected]
2025

### 2025: GAY BAR REPORT THEORY

The Pentagon Pizza Index expanded beyond pizza monitoring to include gay bars near sensitive
government facilities. The theory suggests that unusually quiet activity at LGBTQ+ establishments
during peak hours may indicate personnel working overtime on classified operations, as military and
intelligence staff avoid public venues during high-tempo periods.

[Queerty reported][24] on how this iconic gay bar near the Pentagon became part of open-source
intelligence tracking, with observers noting correlations between quiet nights at establishments
like Freddie's Beach Bar and subsequent military developments in the Middle East.

🏳️‍🌈

#### Inverse Activity Correlation

The gay bar theory operates on an inverse correlation principle: when establishments that typically
see consistent evening traffic suddenly become quiet, it may signal that government personnel are
working extended hours on sensitive matters.

Observers track venues like Freddie's Beach Bar (1.4 mi from Pentagon) and The Little Gay Pub (1.1
mi from White House), monitoring for unusual dips in activity that coincide with geopolitical
tensions.

[Gay Bar Intelligence Monitoring - OSINT Activity Tracking]
2026

### 2026: GENTLEMEN'S DISPATCH THEORY

Gentlemen's Dispatch extends the same open-source pattern logic to strip-club activity around
military communities. The premise is simple: unusual nightlife swings can act as an early signal of
deployment tempo and readiness changes.

A recent [New York Post report][25] describes troops discussing upcoming deployments with a dancer,
adding public anecdotal evidence to the broader OPSEC-signal conversation.

### What is the Pentagon Pizza Index (PizzINT)?

The Pentagon Pizza Index (PizzINT) is a real-time Pentagon pizza tracker that visualizes unusual
activity at Pentagon-area pizzerias. It highlights a signal that has historically aligned with
late-night, high-tempo operations and breaking news. Explore our full platform: [Election Hub][26]
for live prediction market odds, [Polyglobe][27] for global market intelligence, or learn more on
our [About][28] page.
Q

### Is the Pentagon Pizza Theory real or accurate?

It's an OSINT signal supported by historical anecdotes and modern traffic data. Spikes frequently
coincide with elevated watch or major news. Like any single indicator, it's best read in context
with other signals.
Q

### How do I read the dashboard and DOUGHCON levels?

Watch the DOUGHCON display, active spikes, and the overall index. Look for "Busier than usual"
patterns, sustained late-night activity, and multi-location surges — these tend to be higher-signal.

We use public signals such as Google Maps Popular Times and compare them to historical baselines.
Data typically updates about every ~10 minutes. Currently tracking 6 locations. See more in

for medical products from India is high all over the world. India is additionally known to be the
greatest provider of conventional meds from one side of the planet to the other. More than 50% of
the global vaccination demands are fulfilled by pharmaceutical exporter companies from India. Recent
studies have revealed that India contributes to about 20% of the total pharma import and export that

before and during dispatch to prevent physical or chemical deterioration.

Rizochem is one of the front runners in the export of drugs and other pharma products. The demand
for medical products from India is high all over the world. India is additionally known to be the
greatest provider of conventional meds from one side of the planet to the other. More than 50% of
the global vaccination demands are fulfilled by pharmaceutical exporter companies from India. Recent
studies have revealed that India contributes to about 20% of the total pharma import and export that

Driving Growth Through Strategic Deals in Saudi Arabia

Saudi Arabia’s M&A market is gaining momentum, driven by economic diversification, sector
consolidation, private capital activity, and growing demand for strategic acquisitions. We help
business leaders and decision makers turn M&A opportunities into clear strategies, stronger deal
execution, and scalable growth.
