/ Introduction

## Saudi M&A Consulting brings together Pure Consulting’s local understanding of the Saudi market
## and Eurogroup Consulting’s international strategy and transaction expertise to support
## organizations pursuing mergers, acquisitions, partnerships, and strategic deals in the Kingdom.

We work with companies, investors, private equity firms, family businesses, and institutions looking
to assess opportunities, enter new sectors, expand through acquisition, or create value through
strategic transactions in Saudi Arabia.

Our advisory services cover M&A strategy, market screening, commercial due diligence, target
assessment, investment advisory, partnership strategy, value creation planning, post-deal
integration, operating model review, and performance improvement.

Across construction, healthcare, energy, logistics, mobility, tourism, mining, sports, industrials,
and digital ecosystems, we help clients make informed transaction decisions, strengthen
competitiveness, and create long-term value in Saudi Arabia.

## Why Saudi Arabia?

Saudi Arabia is becoming one of the region’s most strategic markets for mergers and acquisitions. In
H1 2025, Saudi Arabia recorded 59 M&A transactions, supported by activity across industrials, TMT,
and financial services. This reflects the Kingdom’s growing role as a dealmaking hub for companies
looking to scale, consolidate, and acquire strategic capabilities.

The momentum is also visible across the wider region. Middle East M&A activity rose to 271 deals in
H1 2025, up 19% year-on-year, while full-year 2025 activity reached 635 completed deals across the
Middle East, up 33% year-on-year. Saudi Arabia remained one of the region’s most active markets,
supported by sovereign capital, corporate growth strategies, inbound investment, and sector
transformation.

The market opportunity is also becoming more complex. Corporates, investors, family businesses, and
private equity firms need to navigate target screening, valuation expectations, due diligence,
regulatory requirements, deal structuring, integration planning, and stakeholder alignment. This
makes the right M&A strategy, partner selection, execution roadmap, and post-deal value creation
plan essential.

**Strategic Deal Momentum:** Saudi Arabia’s M&A market is creating opportunities for companies
looking to scale, consolidate, acquire capabilities, or enter new sectors.

**Private Capital and Corporate Growth:** Corporates, family businesses, investors, and private

**Cross-Sector Opportunity:** Deal activity is emerging across technology, industrials, financial
services, healthcare, infrastructure, consumer markets, and energy-related sectors.

**Post-Deal Value Creation:** As competition for quality assets increases, successful deals require
stronger due diligence, integration planning, and performance improvement.

## What is the Saudi eVisa?

Saudi Arabia is opening its doors to the world through its new tourist visa. Through the fast and
easy-to-use online portal, international visitors from 66 eligible countries can apply for an eVisa
and discover the warm hospitality of Saudi people the rich heritage, vibrant culture, and diverse
and breathtaking landscapes; from the mountains of Abha to the beaches of the Red Sea to the
shifting sands of the Empty Quarter.

The eVisa will be a one-year, multiple entry visa, allowing tourists to spend up to 90 days in the
country. The tourist visa allows you to take part in tourism-related activities such as, events,
family & relatives visits, leisure, and Umrah (excluding Hajj) and excludes other activities such as
studying.

### World Population

retrieving data...
[Current World Population][52]
[+] [–]

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.

Sources for the world population counter:
* [World Population Prospect: the 2024 Revision][54] - United Nations, Department of Economic and
  Social Affairs, Population Division (2024)
* [International Programs Center at the U.S. Census Bureau, Population Division][55]

For more detailed information:
* [World Population][56] (Worldometer)

World Population:

Updated with the [2024 United Nations Revision][53]
* reached 8 billion in 2022, according to United Nations estimates.
* is projected to reach 9 billion in 2037, and 10 billion in 2060.
* has doubled in 40 years from 1959 (3 billion) to 1999 (6 billion).
* is currently (2025) growing at a rate of around 0.85% per year, adding around 70 million people
  per year to the total.
* growth rate reached its peak in the late 1960s, when it was at 2.09%.
* growth rate is currently declining and is projected to continue to decline in the coming years
  (reaching below 0.50% by 2047, reach 0 in 2084, and decline by -0.12% in 2100) .
* a tremendous change occurred with the industrial revolution: whereas it had taken all of human
  history up to the year 1800 for world population to reach 1 billion, the second billion was
  achieved in only 130 years (1930), the third billion in 30 years (1960), the fourth billion in 15
  years (1974), the fifth billion in 13 years (1987), the sixth billion in 11 years (1998), the
  seventh billion and eighth billion in 12 years each (2010 and 2022). During the 20th century
  alone, the population in the world has grown from 1.65 billion to 6 billion.

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
